selection_rule: Candidate must have freeze baseline pytest rc=0.
Production-only historical fix reversion must apply cleanly.
Retained regression tests must then return pytest rc=1.
If multiple valid candidates touch the same production file, prefer the candidate with fewer failing regression-oracle tests.

excluded_valid_candidate.reason: Touches the same production file as N2; N2 has one regression-oracle failure while this candidate has two.
